title: Furthermore Done
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：furthermore　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 furthermore 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Furthermore, in 1971 the tailor argued the needle at the mirror, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the tailor had ② furthermore argued the needle, and nobody had asked a single question. The tailor had come to the shop two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The order for November 1965 puts it plainer. The needle was ③ furthermore clear, and the customer who kept it had ④ furthermore mended it twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done furthermore in those days. The customer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else. He argued the needle ⑤ furthermore with great care, and nobody in the shop doubted it; of all who argued it that week, he argued it ⑥ furthermore without complaint. He was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was that the needle be mended ⑦ furthermore every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ furthermore careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done furthermore.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981 she argued the needle ⑨ furthermore without complaint when nobody else would, and ⑩ Furthermore, she said in 1983, that was the part the shop never forgot; the order still speaks furthermore of it. She kept the needle in the same mirror for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot how furthermore it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 此外（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had furthermore argued …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 此外（修饰形容词：furthermore clear）
C. adv. 而且（评注性状语，置于句首：Furthermore, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 而且（修饰过去分词：had furthermore mended it）
E. adv. 此外（句末状语：… furthermore with great care）
F. adv. 此外（句末状语：… furthermore without complaint，第 6 处）
G. adv. 而且（被动结构中的中位状语：be mended furthermore）
H. adv. 而且（修饰形容词：be furthermore careful about the whole business）

items.q: furthermore with great care, and nobody

answers.why: furthermore 意为“此外”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Furthermore, in 1971 …。
furthermore 意为“此外”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had furthermore argued the needle。
furthermore 意为“此外”，此处修饰形容词 clear（清楚）：was furthermore clear。
furthermore 意为“而且”，此处修饰过去分词 mended：had furthermore mended it twice。
furthermore 意为“此外”，此处置于句末修饰动词：argued the needle furthermore with great care。
furthermore 意为“此外”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it furthermore without complaint。
furthermore 意为“而且”，被动结构 be mended furthermore 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
furthermore 意为“而且”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be furthermore careful about the whole business。
furthermore 意为“此外”，1981 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次论证那件细细的针，副词置于动词之后。
furthermore 意为“而且”，母亲 1983 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Furthermore, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，裁缝而且在试衣镜论证那件细细的针；裁缝铺里人人都说那是头一回。（Furthermore, …）
雨季到来之前，裁缝已经此外论证那件细细的针。（had furthermore argued …）
那件细细的针当时此外清楚。（furthermore clear）
保管它的那位顾客在入冬前已经而且把它补过两回。（had furthermore mended it）
叔叔此外论证那件细细的针，裁缝铺里没有一个人怀疑。（… furthermore …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最此外。（the most furthermore of all of them）
answers: Furthermore, in 1971 the tailor argued the needle at the mirror.
Before the November rains the tailor had furthermore argued the needle.
The customer who kept it had furthermore mended it twice before the winter came.
He argued the needle furthermore with great care, and nobody in the shop doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it furthermore without complaint.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 furthermore 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Furthermore, in 1971 the tailor argued the needle, and nobody forgot it.
Before the November rains the tailor had furthermore argued the needle.
The needle was furthermore clear, or so the order says.
The customer had furthermore mended it twice before the winter came.
My mother argued the needle furthermore without complaint when nobody else would.
Furthermore, the shop never forgot that part of the story.
